summary:
This is Our Solar System!There are 8 planets in our Solar System.
Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune.
All of them go around the Sun.Remember 3 fun facts:
First, Earth is the only planet with life. We live here!
Second, Jupiter is the biggest planet. It is so huge!
Third, Saturn has beautiful rings. It is my favourite!The universe is so big and so beautiful.
Keep exploring, the universe is waiting for you!Thank you!
